info.title: qts research workbench API
info.description:
Run registry, trial ledger, config schema and background pipeline jobs of the `qts`
research workbench. Errors are RFC 7807 problem details (`application/problem+json`)
with a string `detail`. Non-finite floats (NaN / inf) are serialised as `null`.

get.summary: Effective warm-up for the default config
get.description:
Derived from ``risk.min_history_days``, ``alpha.train_min_days`` (with ML),
``alpha.horizon_days`` and the signal lag of the default ``SystemConfig``.  A
launch with ``config_overrides`` is checked against its own config.

sign.title: Sign
sign.description: +1 / -1 as the composite uses the feature; +1 for ML-only features

mean_ic.title: Mean Ic
mean_ic.description: full-sample mean daily rank IC of sign x feature against the training label

t_stat.title: T Stat
t_stat.description: Newey-West t with the label overlap as the bandwidth floor

source.title: Source
source.description: daily_sleeves: daily rank IC per sleeve with Newey-West t; sampled_combined: the sampled ic.parquet (combined only, plain t) for runs written before the sleeve IC was recorded

overlap_days.title: Overlap Days
overlap_days.description: label overlap (horizon + signal lag) the t-statistics allow for

refit_date.title: Refit Date
refit_date.description: first date the refit's model predicts for

train_end.title: Train End
train_end.description: last label date used; the embargo separates it from refit_date

blend_weights.title: Blend Weights
blend_weights.description: ensemble member weights by sleeve (sum 1); empty for a bare model

AlphaRefitWindow.title: AlphaRefitWindow
AlphaRefitWindow.description: One walk-forward refit of the ML sleeve (``alpha_refits.json``).

sleeves.title: Sleeves
sleeves.description: lgbm / ridge / mlp / ensemble, those recorded

importance.title: Importance
importance.description: sleeve -> feature -> one raw value per refit (aligned with `refits`); null where not recorded

recorded.title: Recorded
recorded.description: false for runs written before the refits were recorded

AlphaRefits.title: AlphaRefits
AlphaRefits.description:
Learned weights over time: raw per-sleeve feature importance per refit (the UI
normalises each refit to sum 1), the refit windows and the feature IC table.

AlphaThemeWeights.title: AlphaThemeWeights
AlphaThemeWeights.description: The composite's theme weights by decision date (``theme_weights.parquet``).

avg_daily_cost_bps_of_nav.title: Avg Daily Cost Bps Of Nav

realized_vs_exante_vol_ratio.title: Realized Vs Exante Vol Ratio
realized_vs_exante_vol_ratio.description: realised / ex-ante vol over invested days only; NaN (null) with too few

invested_day_frac.title: Invested Day Frac
invested_day_frac.description: share of decision days with gross exposure > 1e-4 of NAV

effective_n_names.title: Effective N Names
effective_n_names.description: mean over invested days of 1 / sum p_i^2, p_i = |w_i| / gross (null for runs recorded before it)

specific_var_share.title: Specific Var Share
specific_var_share.description: mean specific share of the risk model's ex-ante variance of the book (null when not recorded)

exante_vol_at_gross2.title: Exante Vol At Gross2
exante_vol_at_gross2.description: mean ex-ante annual vol scaled to gross exposure 2: vol x 2 / gross (null when not recorded)

delisting_pnl_ann.title: Delisting Pnl Ann
delisting_pnl_ann.description: annualised sum over delistings of held names of weight x booked delisting return (return on the stock by delisting reason; null for runs recorded before it)

CostSeries.title: CostSeries
CostSeries.description: ``ColumnarSeries<CostComponent>``: USD per decision date by component.

cells.title: Cells
cells.description: one per year of `years`, in order

days.title: Days
days.description: synthetic market length: at least the effective warm-up (GET /api/config/warmup) plus one year; checked against the run's own config at launch

max_days.title: Max Days
max_days.description: backtest only the last N out-of-sample days (quick runs)

LaunchRunRequest.title: LaunchRunRequest
LaunchRunRequest.description:
Strict types (pydantic strict mode): ``"stocks": "60"`` or ``"ml": "true"`` are
rejected, not coerced; the label may not contain control characters.

nav.title: Nav
nav.description: run id -> NAV aligned to `dates` (null where absent)

downsampled.title: Downsampled
downsampled.description: true when the shared axis was thinned to max_points

RunCompare.title: RunCompare
RunCompare.description:
``GET /api/runs/compare?ids=``: NAV series of several runs on one shared date axis
(the union of their realisation dates, thinned to at most ``max_points``), plus the
fold tables, gates and flattened configs the compare view diffs.

n_trials.title: N Trials
n_trials.description: DSR trial count from the ledger family

RunCompareRun.title: RunCompareRun
RunCompareRun.description: One run of a side-by-side comparison.

stocks.title: Stocks
stocks.description: universe size of the input data; null when not recorded

days.title: Days
days.description: days of market data; null when not recorded

RunConfig.title: RunConfig
RunConfig.description: Subset of ``SystemConfig`` the UI reads directly; the full YAML is in ``config_yaml``.

names.title: Names
names.description: constraint names that ever bound, in display order

vol_target_binding.title: Vol Target Binding
vol_target_binding.description: target / caps / bracket / max_solves / no_alpha / solve_failed:* / ''

share_binding.title: Share Binding
share_binding.description: share of rebalances on which each constraint bound

RunConstraints.title: RunConstraints
RunConstraints.description: Per-rebalance constraint log (``constraints.parquet``); empty `dates` for older runs.

execution_venue.title: Execution Venue
execution_venue.description: routing venue of the execution layer, e.g. "closing auction (LOC/MOC)"; null for runs written before it was recorded

latest.description: null when the run has no exposure history

description.title: Description
description.description: what the file holds, for known artifacts; empty otherwise

RunFile.title: RunFile
RunFile.description: One file of the run directory (top level only).

invested_day_frac.title: Invested Day Frac
invested_day_frac.description: share of decision days with gross exposure > 1e-4 of NAV

RunHeadline.title: RunHeadline
RunHeadline.description: Headline numbers shown in the runs list.

headline.description: null while running or after a failure

config_leaves.title: Config Leaves
config_leaves.description: flattened SystemConfig (dotted path -> scalar); empty while running or after a failure

min_days.title: Min Days
min_days.description: warmup_days + one year (trading_days_per_year): the launch floor

risk_days.title: Risk Days
risk_days.description: risk exposures warm-up + min_history_days of factor returns

ml_days.title: Ml Days
ml_days.description: universe lead + alpha.train_min_days + embargo (upper bound); null without ML

exact.title: Exact
exact.description: true when the (exact) risk term binds

Warmup.title: Warmup
Warmup.description:
Effective warm-up of a run (``qts.pipeline.estimate_warmup_days``): trading
days of the market panel used before the first out-of-sample backtest date.

ApiErrorBody.description: RFC 7807 problem details (``application/problem+json``); ``detail`` is always a string.
ApiErrorBody.title: ApiErrorBody
